|translation='''Title:''' Electronic rangefinder.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on any AT-AT Cannon. It may fire at targets two sites away. Also, when used with Target The Main Generator, add 1 to the total.

'''Lore:'''
A long-range stereoscopic sight linked to an Imperial walker's guns. The aiming correction lets an AT-AT commander fire accurately at distant targets.
